content.rendered:
Archer Glen students are encouraged to jump into new adventures this summer by reading some great books. Students earn a prize when they turn in their completed Bingo sheet in the fall.

Summer Reading Bingo sheets were sent home with students the last week of school.

If you have questions about the summer reading program, need to print a Bingo sheet, or OBOB please go to MEDIA CENTER for more information.
